QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />` (lines 128–136). The ref is forwarded as is
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards the ref to NavigationSearch when `hasSearch` is true. It never says the ref is attached to nothing when `hasSearch` is false. It only says the other callers' refs go to their scroll view.
